# Synctrack.io

> Synctrack empower Shopify merchants by providing a unified ecosystem of innovative applications—including PayPal Tracking Sync, Estimated Delivery Date, Returns & Exchanges, and Order Tracking.

## Application Pages (Shopify App Services)
- [Synctrack PayPal Tracking Sync](https://synctrack.io/paypal-tracking/): Auto-Sync Stripe & PayPal Tracking Info for Faster Funds
- [Synctrack Estimated Delivery Date](https://synctrack.io/estimated-delivery-date/): Provide Estimated Delivery Date, Reduce Shipping Inquiries
- [Synctrack Order Tracking]https://synctrack.io/order-tracking/):  Ultimate Order Tracking Solution
- [Synctrack Returns & Exchanges](https://synctrack.io/returns-exchanges/): Returns & Exchanges Management App

## Pricing
- [Plans Overview](https://synctrack.io/pricing/): Find the right Synctrack plan to power your Shopify store

## Knowledge Base
- [Getting Started](https://synctrack.io/knowledge-base/)
- [Member Permission](https://synctrack.io/knowledge-base/returns/member-permission/): Members & Permissions feature in Synctrack Returns enables store and merchant admins to delegate order-management responsibilities to designated staff members—without compromising security or visibility
- [Post-purchase estimated delivery date](https://synctrack.io/knowledge-base/order-tracking/features/estimated-delivery-date/): Post-purchase EDD (Estimated Delivery Date), allows you to provide accurate delivery estimates to your customers. Step-by-step guide to help you effectively use EDD
- [Blacklist locations and keywords](https://synctrack.io/knowledge-base/order-tracking/features/blacklisting/): Keyword blacklisting on the tracking page is a powerful tool of Synctrack Order Tracking that enables merchants to prevent certain words or phrases from being displayed in the tracking information or replace them with keywords of choice. 
- [Tracking Page](https://synctrack.io/knowledge-base/order-tracking/features/tracking-page/): The Tracking Page Editor lets you fully customize how customers look up and track their orders.
